messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Wegovy injection: disodium phosphate dihydrate, sodium chloride, and water for injection. Phenol and propylene glycol are also inactive ingredients in the single-patient-use Wegovy FlexTouch. Hydrochloric acid or sodium hydroxide may be added to adjust pH.
Wegovy tablets: salcaprozate sodium (SNAC) and magnesium stearate
Rybelsus R1 formulation: magnesium stearate, microcrystalline cellulose, povidone, and salcaprozate sodium (SNAC).
Rybelsus R2 formulation: magnesium stearate and salcaprozate sodium (SNAC).
Triplet: ["semaglutide", "may have added", "hydrochloric acid"]

The relation 'may have added' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may include the substance specified by the object entity to adjust or maintain its pH.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'passes into': The subject drug is transferred or present in the substance or medium specified by the object entity.
B. 'requires adjustment of': The subject drug necessitates changes or modifications to the treatment or dosage specified by the object entity.
C. 'metabolism': The subject drug is metabolized in the body in the manner specified by the object entity.
D. 'is a man made form of': The subject drug is a synthetic version of the substance specified by the object entity.
